value.rationale: The graph family is the natural cyclic counterpart to published lexicographic forest constructions; C7 is the first base with two independence-pair orbit types plus triangles. Its D7 character and invariant/antisymmetric dimension polynomial are not specified by the prior nonequivariant wedge theorem, so they resolve a motivated symmetry question for every clique size. Reflection traces distinguish representations with identical ordinary Betti numbers.
